typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MemberID as string,
		Language as string,
		LOB as string,
		MemberlastName as string,
		MemberFirstName as string,
		SubscriberID as string,
		EffectiveDate as string,
		MemberPhoneNumber as string,
		DOB as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive(FileIID = $File_IID,
		{Convert.DOB} = toDate(toString(DOB, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> AddFileId
AddFileId derive({Convert.MemberID} = toString(MemberID),
		{Comvert.LastName} = toString(MemberlastName),
		{Convert.Phone} = toString(MemberPhoneNumber),
		{Convert.Language} = toString(Language),
		{Convert.SubscriberID} = toString(SubscriberID),
		{Convert.FirstName} = toString(MemberFirstName)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_AFFILIATEMEMBERID as string,
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_LASTNAME as string,
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_EFF_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_FILEIMPORT_IID as long,
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_SUBSCRIBERID as string,
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_DOB as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_PHONE as string,
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_FIRSTNAME as string,
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_LANGUAGE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_AFFILIATEMEMBERID = {Convert.MemberID},
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_LASTNAME = {Comvert.LastName},
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_EFF_DT = EffectiveDate,
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_FILEIMPORT_IID = FileIID,
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_SUBSCRIBERID = {Convert.SubscriberID},
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_DOB = {Convert.DOB},
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_PHONE = {Convert.Phone},
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_FIRSTNAME = {Convert.FirstName},
		AFFILIATELIST_STAGING_LANGUAGE = {Convert.Language})) ~> OLEDBDestination
